# Resolvo

> Open-source, self-hosted IT help desk and ticketing system (NestJS + PostgreSQL + Vue/Quasar), in Spanish, English and Portuguese. Includes a requester portal without login, notifications, reports and an MCP server so AI assistants (Claude, Gemini, Codex, Copilot) can manage tickets.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/jmobandod2000/resolvo-helpdesk/blob/main/README.md): features, installation and production deployment
- [AI integration guide](https://github.com/jmobandod2000/resolvo-helpdesk/blob/main/docs/ai/README.md): connect Claude, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI and other MCP clients
- [AI working context](https://github.com/jmobandod2000/resolvo-helpdesk/blob/main/docs/ai/CONTEXTO_IA.md): statuses, fields, rules and REST API summary for assistants
- [MCP server](https://github.com/jmobandod2000/resolvo-helpdesk/tree/main/resolvo-mcp): tools get_catalogs, search_tickets, get_ticket, create_ticket, update_ticket, change_status, add_note, get_follow_up_link, get_metrics, get_report, list_notifications
- [Contributing](https://github.com/jmobandod2000/resolvo-helpdesk/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
